entities.name: RAMP2 (Q9JHJ1)
observations: Supplied 182-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed Rattus norvegicus receptor activity-modifying protein 2 (UniProt Q9JHJ1).
RAMP2 is a single-pass type I membrane accessory protein that modulates GPCRs including CALCRL and CALCR; supports CALCRL delivery to plasma membrane.
With CALCRL, contributes to the adrenomedullin receptor complex; with CALCR, can form calcitonin and amylin receptor complexes.
Annotated processes include adrenomedullin receptor signaling, adenylate-cyclase-activating GPCR signaling, amylin receptor signaling, angiogenesis, and basement-membrane assembly.
Localization annotations include plasma membrane, cell surface, signaling receptor complex, and cytoplasm; human RAMP2 also has clathrin-coated pit and lysosome annotations.
Sequence contains Pfam RAMP domain PF04901.19 at residues 76–179.
